Subject: Final timing check: Q1 pilot or archive?

Hi Sara —

Great to meet you and the TileWorks team earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery so we have the same page: 

- Primary goal: reduce embedding costs for search and recommendation pipeline, target 30–40% cost reduction while keeping p99 latency under 120ms.
- Data controls: data must remain in EU/US multi-tenant, no customer-hosted KV required for pilot.
- Success criteria for pilot: (1) 10k queries/day with <150ms median latency, (2) integrated with their batch retriever, (3) measurable token cost reduction.

Next steps I proposed on the call (attached MAP):
- Redwood: deliver a 4-week pilot plan and pilot config (we already mapped instance types and expected throughput).
- TileWorks: provide a representative query sample and an SSO test account for integration.
- Timeline: aim to start pilot before end of January to validate for Q2 rollout.

Two quick asks for you so I can prioritize:
1) Is pilot timing still a Q1 priority for TileWorks?
2) If not, should I archive this opportunity and circle back in Jan?

Attachment: TW-MAP-20261110.pdf (Mutual Action Plan, 2 pages)

If I don’t hear back, I’ll follow up in a week — didn’t want to clog up your inbox.

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hi Mateo —

Thanks for the follow-up and the MAP. Quick update from our side: we had a product-priority shift tied to a major retail integration that pushed several items off our roadmap. As a result, we are deprioritizing new infrastructure pilots until early Q1.

That said, the team is still interested in Redwood — mainly for the cost savings profile you shared — and we’d like to revisit in the first two weeks of January. For procurement, we’ll want a short pilot SOW and your standard data processing addendum.

Could you send a short SOW and indicative pricing so procurement has something to review over the break? We won’t make a decision before the holidays but this will help speed things in Jan.

Thanks —
